purpose: Where a Tau Ceti roadmap accepted since the atlas's snapshot goes on the map, when its title names no area and the Tau Ceti roadmaps its README names do not settle it (scripts/tauceti_progress.py). Keyed by the roadmap's id on Tau Ceti's Progress page; `galaxy` is an area of data/galaxies.json. A choice here comes before the title and the README.

TauCetiRoadmap/PeripheralActions.reason: the automorphisms of a free pro-p group that preserve its peripheral classes, proved by what its README calls a self-contained group-theoretic argument. The README names BelyiMaps and ProfiniteProPGroups, one in each of two areas.

TauCetiRoadmap/ProfiniteArithmetic.reason: the generic profinite calculus (profinite integers and powers, automorphism groups of profinite groups), which its README calls group theory about every profinite group that no arithmetic roadmap should own. The README names four roadmaps in four areas.

TauCetiRoadmap/OperatorTheory/OperatorId.reason: approximation numbers and symmetric operator ideals of bounded operators. Its README names RepresentationTheory, which put the whole family in representation theory; it is one of Tau Ceti's OperatorTheory roadmaps, whose README describes the family as the theory of bounded operators on Hilbert spaces and the spectral perturbation theory built on it, and which the README rule itself places in analysis, with SelfAdjointSpectralTheory.

TauCetiRoadmap/OperatorTheory/PolarDecom.reason: the polar decomposition of bounded maps through the square root of the positive operator T†T. Its README names only OperatorIdeals, so it followed that into representation theory; it is one of Tau Ceti's OperatorTheory roadmaps, whose README describes the family as the theory of bounded operators on Hilbert spaces and the spectral perturbation theory built on it, and which the README rule itself places in analysis, with SelfAdjointSpectralTheory.

Its arXiv category, math.NT, allows the area, but its title names none, so the category's default (number fields) would otherwise apply.

TauCetiRoadmap/SymplecticGeometry/Contac.reason: contact hyperplane fields, Reeb dynamics, Darboux and Gray stability and Legendrian neighbourhoods. Its README names three topology roadmaps (GeometricTopology, for tubular neighbourhoods; DGFloer and HeegaardFloer, which keep the Floer theory), which put it in topology; it is one of Tau Ceti's SymplecticGeometry roadmaps, whose README describes the family as the smooth geometry of phase spaces, symmetry and reduction, integrable systems and contact structures, and which its arXiv category (math.SG) places in differential geometry, with ConvexityToric.
